claim: Cisco reports $14 million in revenue for Q4 of fiscal 2024
summary: Cisco did report Q4 fiscal 2024, but revenue was on the order of $13-14 billion, not $14 million. The stated amount is wrong by a factor of ~1000.

sub_claims.text: Cisco reported results for Q4 of fiscal 2024
sub_claims.stated_text: Cisco reports ... for Q4 of fiscal 2024
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge Cisco reports quarterly results; Q4 fiscal 2024 ended late July 2024 and was reported in August 2024.

sub_claims.text: Cisco Q4 fiscal 2024 revenue was $14 million
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge Cisco Q4 FY2024 revenue was about $13.6 billion, roughly 1000x larger; $14 million confuses million with billion and is materially false.
